        /// <summary>
        /// Cnvert a file, line by line, into a list, then clean it.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="filePath">The path of the file to convert.</param>
        /// <param name="removeBlanks">Flag to clean blank lines [true/false].</param>
        /// <param name="commentCharacter">The comment character (i.e '#', or "null" if not cleaning comments).</param>
        /// <returns>The file contents as a list.</returns>
        public static List<string> ToList(StreamReader filePath, bool removeBlanks, char? commentCharacter)
        {
            /*  This works with external files and embedded resources, provided you pass the file as as a StringReader
             *  object. If the file is external, use the following code when calling this method:
             *
             *      var filePath = new System.IO.StreamReader("path/to/file");
             *      Du.File.ToStringDictionary(filePath);
             *
             *  If the file is embedded, use the following code when calling this method:
             *
             *      var assemblyName = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
             *      var filePath     = new System.IO.StreamReader(assemblyName.GetManifestResourceStream("path/to/file"));
             *      Du.File.ToStringDictionary(filePath);
             */
            var isBlank      = false;
            var isComment    = false;
            var originalList = DuFile.ToList(filePath);
            var workList     = new List<string>();

            foreach (var item in originalList)
            {
                isBlank = DuString.CheckIsBlank(item);
                isComment = DuString.CheckIsComment(item, commentCharacter);

                if (removeBlanks && isBlank || commentCharacter != null && isComment || commentCharacter == null)
                {
                    workList.Add(item);
                }
            }

            return workList;
        }
